title: Drain engine oil, coolant, transmission oil; discharge A/C

notices.text: A/C MUST be discharged and recovered by a licensed shop before the condenser/compressor lines are opened — venting R134a is illegal. The 996 cooling system holds a lot of coolant and it does not all come out of the radiator drains; open the bleeder on the expansion tank and pull the lower hose at the thermostat housing. Expect to chase residual coolant for a while. Catch and measure what comes out so you know what to put back.

steps.text: Drain engine oil, coolant, transmission oil; discharge A/C.

sources.ref: Knowledge Gruppe, Fastening Specifications 996, p.15 item 23 (M18 x 1.5); WSM Gr.1 Part 1 (M96/01 edition) p.1-1, 03-1

fasteners.name: Manual transmission drain / fill plug
fasteners.note: Open the FILL plug first — if you cannot open it, do not drain.
